concept: CloudTrail: multi-Region trail and log file integrity validation
tests: Knowing CloudTrail settings for full Region coverage and provably unaltered logs.
expected: Multi-Region trail (all Regions) + log file integrity validation (signed digest files). Triggers: "tamper-evident", "every AWS Region", "audit logs of all API activity".
why_not: EC2 detailed monitoring is metric frequency, unrelated to auditing; CloudWatch Logs retention is storage duration, not Region coverage or tamper protection.
